title: Implement location/navigation characteristic mappings (K.3.4)
description:
Add to gatt_ipso.c static table, location/navigation characteristics:

- Location & Speed 0x2A67 -> 3336/6051, lat/lon/m
- Latitude 0x2AAE -> 3336/6051, lat
- Longitude 0x2AAF -> 3336/6052, lon
- Altitude 0x2AB3 -> 3336/6053, m
- Floor Number 0x2AB2 -> 3337/5700, 1
- Position Quality 0x2A69 -> 3336/6054, m
- Heading 0x2A68 -> 3320/5700, deg
- Speed 0x2A67 -> 3336/5700, m/s (secondary resource for Location & Speed)

~8 entries. Reference: spec/appendix-gatt-ipso.md K.3.4
